home.title: One bus. One driver. Your whole journey planned around it.
home.lede: Sisara Coach hires out a single, meticulously maintained coach for weddings, pilgrimages, school trips and tours across Sri Lanka — so every booking gets our full attention.
home.intro_title: Built around one bus, run without compromise
home.intro_body: Because we operate a single coach, every trip is planned in detail — no double bookings, no substitute vehicles, no surprises on the day.
home.f1_body: You deal with the owner directly, not a call centre. Every request gets a personal reply.
home.f2_body: Our calendar reflects the one bus we run, so the date you request is the date you get.
home.f3_body: Airport transfers, weddings, school trips, pilgrimages, company outings and multi-day tours.
home.featured_title: A coach built for long Sri Lankan roads
home.featured_body: Comfortable seating, full air conditioning and a driver who knows the coastal and hill routes well. See full specifications on the Bus Details page.
home.contact_body: Send a booking request and we'll confirm availability by phone or WhatsApp, usually within a few hours.

about.title: A family business, one coach at a time
about.history_body: Sisara Coach started with a single vehicle and a simple idea: give every hire our complete attention instead of spreading a fleet thin. That approach hasn't changed.
about.mission_body: To make private coach travel in Sri Lanka dependable — clear pricing, real availability, and a driver who treats your trip like his own family's.
about.experience_body: Years of coastal routes, hill-country transfers, pilgrimage convoys and long wedding days have shaped how we plan every journey, down to rest stops and pickup timing.
